text:
Predicates:
Timeless(x) ::: x is timeless.
DesignStyle(x, y) ::: x has design style y.
MassProductDesign(x) ::: x is a mass product design.
Evocative(x) ::: x is evocative.
Dreamy(x) ::: x is dreamy.
DesignBy(x, y) ::: x is a design by y.
Max(x) ::: x is Max.
Question: Based on the above information, is the following statement true, false, or uncertain? A design by Max is either evocative or dreamy.
Conclusion: ∀x (DesignBy(x, Max) → Evocative(x) ∨ Dreamy(x))
